description: Test suite for the Kubernetes resource claim controller, including tests for sync handler, event handlers, and metrics related to resource claims, claim templates, and extended resources.

methods.name: TestSyncHandler
methods.description: Tests the synchronization handler for various scenarios including creation, update, deletion, conflicts, and metrics updates.

methods.name: TestResourceClaimTemplateEventHandler
methods.description: Tests the event handler for resource claim templates, ensuring correct queueing and indexing of pods.

methods.name: TestResourceClaimEventHandler
methods.description: Tests the event handler for resource claims, verifying queueing, updates, deletions, and metrics.

methods.name: TestGetAdminAccessMetricLabel
methods.description: Validates the logic for extracting admin access labels from resource claims.

methods.name: TestEnqueuePodExtendedResourceClaims
methods.description: Tests the enqueueing logic for pods with extended resource claims, considering feature gates and pod phases.
